name: Technoprobe S.p.A.
summary: Technoprobe S.p.A., an Italian-based firm, manufactures and distributes electronic circuitry across Italy and globally. The company's offerings also include mechanical interfaces specifically designed for establishing electrical connections with hybrid circuits and semiconductor devices. A key area of expertise for Technoprobe involves the conceptualization, advancement, and fabrication of probe cards, which are essential tools for verifying the operational integrity of integrated circuits (chips). These sophisticated products are utilized across a broad spectrum of applications, encompassing digital data and 5G technologies, the Internet of Things (IoT), data center infrastructure, the automotive sector including autonomous vehicles, telecommunications and media, industrial and aerospace engineering, and consumer electronics. Established in 1993, Technoprobe S.p.A. is headquartered in Cernusco Lombardone, Italy, and operates as a subsidiary of T-Plus S.P.A.
